DeeDee Animation Studio, part of Sáng Ý Group, excels in all stages of 2D animation production, from concept to post-production, across various formats like series, short films, and commercials. Renowned for the creativity and professionalism, we collaborate with leading animation clients like Duncan Studio, Shin-ei Animation, 6 Point Harness, etc. and have won prestigious awards, including the Best 2D Film at the KHEM Animation Film Festival (2019), the Golden Kite Award (2020), and the Winner of Vietnam Animation IP Contest (2025).
